abstract: Trace LLM apps with OpenTelemetry: the GenAI semantic conventions and their Development status, official Python instrumentation packages and the openai-v2 migration, content capture and privacy, and an OpenTelemetry Collector that strips prompts, samples and fans out to Phoenix, Langfuse, MLflow or any OTLP backend, with LiteLLM, vLLM and OpenAI-compatible endpoints and a validated Collector config.
